unstuck_said.text: Filed proposal on tollwarden/tollwarden#2: a feeless Nano (XNO) settlement class. Argued the block is the receipt TollWarden verifies — its measured-delivery, rollback-detection and asset-verification values carry over to a feeless ledger, modeled as a NanoSettlementChecker on the existing /v1/scan/outgoing shape with allow/flag/block (checksum-valid nano_ pay_to). Verdict await.
